changes.t: The 10-year is 4 bp below last Friday and 15 bp below its Oct 28 close of 5.05%; the 2-year fell 3 bp to 4.58% and the 30-year 4 bp to 5.28%.
Oil is down about 17% from $113.43 on Oct 30 on hopes of pressure to pull back from the U.S.–Iran war, though four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Dow rose 1,569 points to 53,356 and the S&P 500 closed near 7,689; energy and defense stocks fell while HCA rose 10.3% and Nvidia fell 3.1%.
Volatility dropped from 20.83 as the election removed a source of uncertainty; the Trading tab's regime score was 47 (Fragile) as of the Nov 3 close.

changes.h: December hike odds rise to about 80% from 72%
changes.t: Kalshi was at 80.5% and Polymarket 79.5% on Nov 4 after Tuesday's 7.52M job openings report; a January hike is about 26%.
Treasury kept next week's 3-, 10- and 30-year sales at $58B, $42B and $25B but now expects steady sizes only "for the next several quarters," dropping "at least."

changes.h: H100 low rental price jumps to $3.40 an hour

2026-11-04.headline: Democrats win Congress; oil sinks 8.6% and the Dow jumps 1,569 points

items.t: $58B of 3-year notes (Nov 9), $42B of 10-year notes (Nov 10) and $25B of 30-year bonds (Nov 12) raise about $28B of new cash.
The Dow rose 1,569 points, Brent fell 8.6% to $94.64 and the 10-year closed at 4.90%.

items.h: December hike odds climb to about 80%
items.t: Kalshi priced a Dec 9 hike at 80.5% and Polymarket at 79.5%, up from about 72% on Nov 3.
The starter-homes question led 50.8% to 49.2% with about 49% of votes counted early Wednesday; Healey and Ayotte were reelected.

items.h: 210 Broadway in Cambridge sells at a loss
items.t: Bulfinch bought the 64,812 SF building from BioMed for $15.1M, about $233/SF, versus $23.5M in 2012.

items.h: Mattapan garage sold for affordable housing
items.t: 1590 Blue Hill Ave. traded for $8.75M for a planned 105-unit income-restricted building, about $83K per unit.

items.h: IWG adds six flex office sites in Massachusetts
items.t: New Regus and HQ locations in Boston, Worcester, Somerville, North Andover, Holbrook and Charlestown bring IWG to 50 in the state.

items.h: Randolph hotel and dinner theater proposed
items.t: A 200-room, 171K SF hotel and 65K SF events building are planned on 13 acres at the former Lombardo's site.
Sizes were held at $125B; next up are Freddie Mac's survey on Nov 5 (last 7.24%) and the October jobs report on Nov 6 (about 65,000 expected).
The lowest Vast.ai H100 price rose from $2.27 a day earlier; B200 held at $6.25.

2026-11-04.summary: Democrats won control of the House and Senate, Brent fell 8.6% to $94.64 and the Dow rose 3.0%, its best day since April 2025, while the 10-year closed 5 bp lower at 4.90%. Lower oil and long yields ease fuel, heating and fixed-rate borrowing costs for Boston and New Hampshire owners, but December hike odds rose to about 80%, which points to higher costs on SOFR-based floating loans.

changes.t: Its biggest drop since Oct 22; the 10-year fell 6 bp to 4.84%, its lowest close since Sep 9 and 10 bp below last Friday, and the 30-year fell 3 bp to 5.25%.
The Nasdaq closed in correction territory as the chip index fell 12.3%; the Dow lost 1,833 points to 51,523, erasing Wednesday's rally.
Volatility rose from 16.61; the Trading tab's regime score was 47 (Fragile) as of the Nov 3 close, before this week's swings.

changes.h: December hike odds fall to 69% from 80%
changes.t: Kalshi was at 69% and Polymarket 69.5% on Nov 5; Kalshi's January hike odds slipped to 24%.
Down from 7.24%, a third straight weekly decline; the 15-year fell to 6.57% and Mortgage News Daily's daily rate was 7.17%.
Oil rebounded after three straight declines from $113.43 on Oct 30 to $94.62 on Nov 4.
October's debt statement showed bills up $264B on the month to $7.38T.

changes.h: A100 low rental price rises to $1.08
changes.t: Vast.ai's lowest A100 price rose from $0.949 on Nov 4 while the H100 floor held at $3.40 (Nov 5 overnight reading).

2026-11-05.headline: AI stock rout sinks the Nasdaq 5.5%; 2-year Treasury yield falls 12 bp

items.t: Marketable Treasury debt reached about $32.1T at Oct 31, with bills up $264B to $7.38T ahead of next week's $125B refunding.

items.h: AI rout sinks the Nasdaq into a correction
items.t: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% and the 2-year Treasury yield 12 bp to 4.46% as money moved into bonds.
Kalshi and Polymarket priced a Dec 9 hike near 69%, down from about 80% on Nov 4.

items.h: Mortgage rates fall for a third week
items.t: Freddie Mac's 30-year averaged 7.18%, down from 7.24%.
The starter-homes question was behind 49.4% to 50.6% on Nov 5, and the AP had not called it.

items.h: Healthpeak adds to its Alewife campus
items.t: The REIT agreed to buy a West Cambridge building at Cambridge Discovery Park for $36M.
The council voted to cut the required income-restricted share to 10% from 15% for projects of eight or more units.
Active listings were up 24.9% from a year earlier in October, per Realtor.com.
Claims dropped 6,000 in the week ended Oct 31, below the 197,000 forecast.
The 30-year fell to 7.18%; next is the October jobs report on Nov 6, with about 59,000 jobs expected.
The lowest Vast.ai A100 price rose from $0.949 a day earlier; H100 held at $3.40 and B200 at $6.25.

2026-11-05.summary: An AI-stock selloff sent the Nasdaq down 5.5% into a correction and the S&P 500 down 4.4%, and investors moved into Treasuries: the 2-year fell 12 bp to 4.46% and the 10-year 6 bp to 4.84%, its lowest close since Sep 9. Lower long rates and a 7.18% Freddie Mac mortgage rate ease fixed-rate borrowing costs for Boston and New Hampshire owners, and December hike odds fell to 69%, though a hike that would raise floating-rate costs is still favored.

changes.h: December hike odds rise to 77% from 69%
changes.t: Kalshi was at 77.5% and Polymarket 76.5% after the jobs report; January hike odds fell to about 21% and March to 42%.
Far above forecasts near 60,000; unemployment fell to 4.1%, wages rose 3.1% over the year, and August and September were revised up 84,000.
The 10-year rose 2 bp to 4.86% and the 30-year 1 bp to 5.26%, narrowing the 2- to 10-year gap to 35 bp.
Chip stocks recovered part of Thursday's rout while the Dow fell 0.5%; both the Nasdaq and S&P 500 still lost about 3% for the week.

changes.h: High-yield spread widens 16 bp to 348 bp
changes.t: The Nov 5 reading, during the stock rout; investment grade widened to 93 bp from 91 bp.

changes.h: Regime score falls to 34, now Stressed
changes.t: Down from 48 as of the Nov 5 close, with the VIX at 28.18; the TQQQ signal moved from wait to accumulate. The VIX eased to 25.64 on Friday.
The AP called the starter-homes question on Nov 6; "no" led by 32,322 votes of about 2.54 million.

changes.h: H100 rental floor falls to $2.27 from $3.40
changes.t: Vast.ai's lowest B200 price rose to $8.75 from $6.25 and the H200 floor fell to $3.50 from $5.20 (Nov 6 overnight reading).

2026-11-06.headline: Strong October jobs report lifts December hike odds to 77%

items.h: Junk spreads widen in the rout
items.t: The ICE BofA high-yield spread rose to 348 bp on Nov 5 from 332 bp, and investment grade to 93 bp.
About $58B of orders; the 2056 notes priced 220 bp over Treasuries, nearly 0.9 point wider than a similar April note.
Orders of about €53B were the most ever for a single-company euro bond.
The seven-part high-grade sale drew about $31B of orders on Nov 5.
October hiring far exceeded forecasts and unemployment fell to 4.1%.
Up from about 69% on Nov 5 after the jobs report.
The starter-homes measure lost by about 1.2 points, the AP said on Nov 6.

items.h: Westborough shopping center set for auction
items.t: A 371,425 SF center anchored by Stop & Shop and Staples, with a $30.75M mortgage, goes to foreclosure auction Dec 8.

items.h: Revere weighs 40R district for public housing rebuild
items.t: The plan would raise the site to 1,700 units, including 910 market-rate units.

items.h: Brighton project could triple to 143 units
items.t: DND Homes wants a six-story, 93,612 SF building instead of the approved 44 units.

items.h: Stocks recover part of Thursday's losses
items.t: The Nasdaq rose 1.09% and the S&P 500 0.32%, but the S&P 500 lost 2.68% for the week.
Payrolls rose 165,000 and unemployment was 4.1%; next is October CPI on Nov 10.

items.h: Airbnb and Axon lead the big moves
items.t: In the page's midday Nov 6 snapshot, Airbnb was up 12.3% and Axon down 18.7%, while Nvidia rose 2.2%.

items.h: Regime turns Stressed; TQQQ signal to accumulate
items.t: As of the Nov 5 close the score fell to 34 from 48, all four TQQQ entry conditions were met, and recession odds were 16.9%.
Vast.ai's lowest H100 price fell to $2.27 from $3.40, while the B200 floor rose to $8.75.

2026-11-06.summary: October payrolls rose 165,000, far above forecasts near 60,000, and unemployment slipped to 4.1%, pushing December hike odds to 77% from 69% and the 2-year yield up 5 bp to 4.51%. The 10-year rose only 2 bp to 4.86% and is still 8 bp below last Friday, so fixed-rate loan quotes for Boston and New Hampshire properties held near recent lows, while a likely December hike keeps pressure on floating-rate debt.
